metadata.name: metrex_exchange
metadata.description: MetrEx Exchange v2: binary outcome tokens and an escrowed order book (docs/spec-v2.md)

accounts.name: previous_round
docs: `config.latest_round`; required once any round exists. Read-only.

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: mUSD. Every collateral token account is checked against it.

accounts.name: escrow_mint
docs: Collateral for BUY, the outcome mint for SELL (side/outcome match checked in the handler).

accounts.name: receive_mint
docs: The outcome mint for BUY, collateral for SELL.

accounts.name: outcome_mint
docs: The market's YES or NO mint, matching `outcome` (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: round
docs: Read-only: fills never write Round (§6.6).

accounts.name: market
docs: Read-only: fills never write Market (§6.6).

accounts.name: receive_mint
docs: The counter-asset (checked against the order's side and outcome in the handler).

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not authorized for this action

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: Token mint does not match this market or Config

errors.name: InvalidTokenAccount
errors.msg: Token account owner or address is not the expected one

errors.name: InvalidMintConfig
errors.msg: Collateral mint must have 6 decimals and no freeze authority

errors.name: RoleConflict
errors.msg: Admin, round controller and oracle must be distinct, non-default keys

errors.name: InvalidCoordinates
errors.msg: Latitude or longitude out of range

errors.name: InvalidTriggerDistance
errors.msg: Trigger distance must be positive

errors.name: UnsupportedScenario
errors.msg: Scenario is not supported

errors.name: ScenarioMismatch
errors.msg: Property scenario does not match the round

errors.name: PreviousRoundOpen
errors.msg: The previous round is still open

errors.name: InvalidDeadline
errors.msg: Trading deadline is invalid

errors.name: InvalidTimeout
errors.msg: Resolution timeout is out of bounds

errors.name: RoundNotOpen
errors.msg: Round is not open

errors.name: TradingEnded
errors.msg: Trading deadline has passed

errors.name: RoundNotClosed
errors.msg: Round is not closed

errors.name: MarketResolved
errors.msg: Market is already resolved

errors.name: MarketNotResolved
errors.msg: Market is not resolved

errors.name: ResolutionWindowClosed
errors.msg: The oracle resolution window has closed

errors.name: ResolutionWindowOpen
errors.msg: The oracle resolution window is still open

errors.name: InvalidEvidenceHash
errors.msg: Evidence hash must be non-zero

errors.name: InvalidOutcome
errors.msg: Outcome must be 0 (YES) or 1 (NO)

errors.name: InvalidSide
errors.msg: Side must be 0 (BUY) or 1 (SELL)

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: Price must be between 1 and 9,999 basis points

errors.name: InvalidQuantity
errors.msg: Quantity is out of range

errors.name: InvalidExpiry
errors.msg: Expiry must be zero or in the future

errors.name: OrderExpired
errors.msg: Order has expired

errors.name: OrderNotActive
errors.msg: Order has no remaining quantity

errors.name: OrderMismatch
errors.msg: Orders do not belong to the same market, outcome or opposite sides

errors.name: OrderSeqMismatch
errors.msg: Order sequence does not match the quoted order

errors.name: OrdersDoNotCross
errors.msg: Buy price is below sell price

errors.name: PriceLimitExceeded
errors.msg: Order price is outside the taker's limit

errors.name: SelfTrade
errors.msg: Maker and taker are the same wallet

errors.name: NotSweepable
errors.msg: Order cannot be swept yet

errors.name: InsufficientPairs
errors.msg: Quantity exceeds outstanding pairs

errors.name: LosingOutcome
errors.msg: These shares did not win

errors.name: InsufficientFunds
errors.msg: Insufficient token balance

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: NotImplemented
errors.msg: Instruction not implemented in this build

types.name: Config
docs: Seeds `["config"]` (§6.1).

fields.name: latest_round
docs: `Pubkey::default()` until the first round. The frontend features this round.

types.name: Market
docs: Seeds `["market", round, property_id: u16 LE]` (§6.4).

fields.name: pairs_outstanding
docs: `split` adds, `merge` subtracts. Booked backing before resolution (§4.6).

fields.name: outcome
docs: 1 Yes, 2 No, 3 Invalid.

fields.name: path
docs: `PATH_ORACLE`, `PATH_EMERGENCY` or `PATH_EXPIRY`.

types.name: Order
docs: Seeds `["order", market, maker, client_nonce: u64 LE]` (§6.5). Escrow: `["escrow", order]`.

fields.name: outcome
docs: `OUTCOME_YES` or `OUTCOME_NO`.

fields.name: side
docs: `SIDE_BUY` or `SIDE_SELL`.

fields.name: seq
docs: Priority; lower is older. Not a seed.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: 0 = no expiry.

fields.name: buy_order
docs: `Pubkey::default()` when the buyer was a direct taker.

fields.name: sell_order
docs: `Pubkey::default()` when the seller was a direct taker.

fields.name: maker_order
docs: The older (resting) order whose price applied.

types.name: Property
docs: Seeds `["property", property_id: u16 LE]` (§6.2). Same layout as v1.1.

fields.name: label
docs: UTF-8, zero-padded.

types.name: Round
docs: Seeds `["round", round_id: u64 LE]` (§6.3).

constants.name: INVALID_PAYOUT_PER_SHARE
docs: Base units paid per share of either outcome when the market is Invalid.

constants.name: PAYOUT_PER_SHARE
docs: Base units paid per winning share.

constants.name: QUOTE_PER_SHARE_BPS
docs: `quote = quantity × price_bps × QUOTE_PER_SHARE_BPS`.
